text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on July 2, 2025, as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. In the same thread he confirmed the ticket is for Tansleigh Packaging (TSP), not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see that conversation himself.

I didn't mention a separate Door 6 issue at Tansleigh's Marietta plant, ticket #4912. It's a different problem (a phantom lock when flatbeds check in), and it only appears in an email Hollis can't see.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on June 9, 2026, saying the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to that ticket. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so he can see that message himself. I also passed on the issue Hollis flagged there: the import file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs fixing before anyone reimports.
